massivedisfunction_assessment.compatible_special_case: With the initial charm density set to zero, the source's old FONLL-A branch is the no-intrinsic-charm S-ACOT case compatible with the accepted perturbative-charm contract.
massivedisfunction_assessment.future_configuration: At each predeclared component point use the accepted masses, PDF member and alpha_s inputs and explicitly call SetPrec(6.25e-5). alpha_s_architecture.scientific_rationale: APFEL 3.1.1 exposes reference-value and evolution controls but no external alpha_s callback. Exact provider identity is therefore unavailable; numerical equivalence over the bounded domain is the relevant closure question.

provider_a.identity: CT18NLO DataVersion 1 member 0 LHAPDF6 alphasQ provider
provider_a.representation: AlphaS_Type=ipol over the 37 serialized AlphaS_Qs/AlphaS_Vals produced from a HOPPET running solution; LHAPDF 6.5.6 uses piecewise cubic Hermite interpolation in log(Q2)
provider_a.metadata: MZ=91.1870 GeV; AlphaS_MZ=0.118000; AlphaS_OrderQCD=1; variable flavor; NumFlavors=5; MCharm=1.3000; MBottom=4.7500

provider_b.identity: APFEL 3.1.1 commit 72bf6ec7c72c923dd2115f2a98c6f593f9c91d2a AlphaQCD exact evolution (source-fixed 10-step classical RK4 per flavor segment)

future_equivalence_test.comparison_points: 257 fixed log-Q nodes including endpoints, all 21 CT18 AlphaS_Qs inside the domain, MZ=91.187, and mb*(1-2^-20), mb, mb*(1+2^-20); duplicates remain recorded; maximum 282 calls per provider
future_equivalence_test.threshold_semantics: Evaluate and label below, exact and above sides separately; no cross-side interpolation or averaging is allowed.
future_equivalence_test.ct18_interpolation_envelope: E_CT18_ipol(Q) is the half-width from an 80-decimal directed-rounding replay of the exact LHAPDF 6.5.6 log(Q2) cubic formula, with every authoritative six-decimal AlphaS_Val independently enclosed by +/-5e-7; threshold subgrids are replayed separately.
future_equivalence_test.apfel_precision_envelope: Using mpmath 1.3.0 with mp.dps=80, independently replay the NLO beta function and matching at every threshold with classical RK4 step counts 20,40,80,160 per flavor segment. With d_n=|A_n-A_(n/2)| require d_80<=d_40/8 and d_160<=d_80/8, then E_APFEL_RK4=|alpha_APFEL-A_160|+d_160/7+1e-70. Failure of either ratio is INCONCLUSIVE_PROVIDER_PRECISION.
future_equivalence_test.atol_derivation: atol(Q)=E_CT18_ipol(Q)+E_APFEL_RK4(Q): the first term propagates half-last-decimal CT18 table intervals through the actual cubic interpolant; the second bounds APFEL's fixed-10-step RK4 against a converged 80-decimal refinement sequence.
future_equivalence_test.rtol_derivation: 32 binary64 unit roundoffs cover only Q conversion, returned-value transport and final subtraction; provider interpolation and RK4 truncation are carried in the absolute envelopes.
future_equivalence_test.budget_gate: The propagated alpha_s rate contribution, including both absolute envelopes and the transport term, must be <=T_ALPHA_S_EQUIVALENCE*S_node with T_ALPHA_S_EQUIVALENCE=0.000125; otherwise the result is NUMERICAL_BUDGET_FAILURE or INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.
future_equivalence_test.near_zero_rule: alpha_s is strictly positive on the bounded domain; a nonpositive or nonfinite value is CONTRACT_IDENTITY_FAILURE, not a relative comparison.
future_equivalence_test.failure: Any finite discrepancy outside the mixed bound is ALPHA_S_EQUIVALENCE_FAILURE; missing provider/point or unresolved threshold-side behavior is INCONCLUSIVE, never PASS.

pdf_apfel_bridge_contract.accepted_pdf_artifact: ct18nlo_two_parameter_boundary_v2 / ct18nlo_member0_sumrule_projected_boundary_v2 at each of nine theta anchors
pdf_apfel_bridge_contract.q_interpretation: Q is an energy scale in GeV, not Q2; the accepted boundary is evaluated only at its exact Q0 and any other callback Q fails the bridge contract.
pdf_apfel_bridge_contract.value_convention: ContinuousPdfPoint::densities returns number densities f_i; the bridge returns x*f_i exactly once.
pdf_apfel_bridge_contract.support_policy: Every x,Q query is checked before evaluation; no extrapolation, zero continuation, clamping or post-hoc deletion is permitted on the declared physics domain.
pdf_apfel_bridge_contract.alpha_s_responsibility: The callback provides PDFs only. APFEL provider_b supplies observable/evolution alpha_s; provider equivalence is separately governed by AS2.

future_validation_test.synthetic_test: Inject 14 distinct exactly representable sentinel x*f values and require exact slot recovery, including PDG-21 to APFEL-0 and zero top/photon slots.
future_validation_test.accepted_value_test: At all nine theta anchors and every x node of the fixed 17/33/65 levels at exact Q0, instrument callback outputs and compare all 14 slots with x*ContinuousPdfPoint::densities(x).
future_validation_test.criterion: |bridge-expected| <= (16*u)*max(|bridge|,|expected|), u=2^-53; exact-zero heavy/top/photon slots must be bitwise +0.0.
future_validation_test.near_zero_rule: There is no absolute floor: exact-zero slots must be bitwise +0.0, while any nonzero sign disagreement or value outside the homogeneous transport bound fails.
future_validation_test.failure: Any flavor, convention, Q, support, finiteness, signed-zero or tolerance mismatch is BRIDGE_IDENTITY_FAILURE.

numerical_error_budget.allocation_rule: Eight load-bearing relative contributions receive equal worst-case triangle-inequality shares because no pre-execution evidence justifies privileging one numerical path.

components.bound: Propagated per-flavor mixed bridge bounds through recorded coefficient weights.

numerical_error_budget.absolute_floors: Provider serialization and binary64 roundoff floors are carried explicitly in E_i and E_total; if they dominate S_node, the point is near-zero/inconclusive rather than relaxed to PASS.
numerical_error_budget.double_counting_policy: Each primitive discrepancy is assigned once. Comparator observed differences are acceptance checks, not additional terms added to the propagated rate envelope.
numerical_error_budget.failure: Any component above its share is NUMERICAL_BUDGET_FAILURE; an unresolved fixed refinement is INCONCLUSIVE.

negative_rate_policy.assembly_definition: r_hat=K*(c2*F2_hat+cL*FL_hat+c3*xF3_hat), with signed coefficients fixed by the accepted e-p HERA convention
negative_rate_policy.total_formula: E_total=E_upstream+E_outer; every primitive error term is recorded once and must satisfy its numerical sub-budget
negative_rate_policy.global_semantics: Any INCONCLUSIVE_SIGN point prevents a global positivity PASS.
negative_rate_policy.optional_binary128_outer_assembly: Diagnostic only; it may reduce E_outer evidence but cannot erase E_upstream or change INCONCLUSIVE_SIGN to PASS by itself.

normalized_law_error_propagation.definitions: q=r/Z; estimates r_hat and Z_hat have |r-r_hat|<=E_r and |Z-Z_hat|<=E_Z
normalized_law_error_propagation.precondition: Z_hat>E_Z and Z_hat>0; otherwise normalization is INCONCLUSIVE or FAIL if a nonpositive value is established.
normalized_law_error_propagation.near_zero_rate: When r_hat is near zero, the first absolute term remains; no division by r_hat and no relative-only rule is used.
normalized_law_error_propagation.z_estimate: Z_hat=(Z_A+Z_B)/2 and E_Z=(|Z_A-Z_B|+E_A+E_B)/2 after both independent fixed paths satisfy their allocated budgets.
normalized_law_error_propagation.cross_normalization: Evaluate I_A[r]/Z_B and I_B[r]/Z_A; same-path I_A[r]/Z_A=1 is algebraic and cannot count as closure.
normalized_law_error_propagation.closure_bound: Each cross residual is bounded by the corresponding interval expression derived from E_A, E_B and the positive lower denominator; there is no standalone residual threshold.
normalized_law_error_propagation.failure: Residual outside the propagated interval is NORMALIZATION_FAILURE; overlapping but nonconverged intervals are INCONCLUSIVE.

jacobian_audit.forward_error_argument: The positive finite calculation uses one multiplication for s*x, one reciprocal/division, an independently ordered analytic evaluation and one comparison subtraction; eight unit roundoffs conservatively cover these operations without cancellation in the Jacobian itself.

resource_bounds.derivation: 63882+98811+310+2*282+9*(17+33+65)+282+338400=503284. The 282 high-precision envelope calls each fix 20+40+80+160=300 RK4 steps with four beta-RHS evaluations per step, hence 282*1200=338400; no adaptive continuation is allowed.

outcome_derivation: All four AR2 blockers are resolved at the specification level, every load-bearing graph node has an oracle or a fixed post-authorization test, and no physics result is used. Actual checks remain unexecuted and require a new authorization review.
remaining_limitations: The complete NC rate still lacks a wholly independent end-to-end implementation; only bounded component closure is planned.
The nine theta anchors do not establish every interior theta.
All alpha_s, bridge, FONLL, positivity, convergence and normalization results remain post-authorization and unexecuted.
Inclusive NC e-p data do not establish unrestricted flavor separation.
